boundary_rule.action_signal: Final component of recorded action vector; open endpoint is 1 and closed endpoint is 0.
boundary_rule.pick: PICK ends at the first frame where the action signal reaches 0 and remains unchanged on the following frame.
boundary_rule.place: PLACE ends at the first frame where the action signal reaches 1 and remains unchanged on the following frame.
boundary_rule.phase_assignment: step_NN_pick includes episode start (or the previous PLACE endpoint plus one) through the PICK endpoint. step_NN_place starts at the following frame and includes the PLACE endpoint. Both phases use the manipulated object. The final post-PLACE return is unlabeled.
boundary_rule.validation: Each episode must start open, contain exactly ordered PICK/PLACE events for every recipe object, and finish open. This does not establish physical task success.
